desc:
✈️ A plane just landed on a dirt road, and the Inspector is on his way. Hide it before he gets here!

How to Play:
🔨 Pry, saw, smash and grind the plane apart in first person.
🎒 Fill your sack with scrap and carry it to the building going up.
🏡 Every load builds the village: the plane becomes a diner, a windmill, a market and more.
🛠️ Buy better tools in the Gear Shop and upgrade them in the Upgrade Book.
👥 Play solo or squad up with up to 4 friends at the Hangar Yard's start pads.
📦 Earn crates, fit mods to your tools and build new tools from blueprints.
💾 Solo runs save, so you can pick up where you left off.

🎮 Plays on PC, phone, tablet and console.
